segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let numbersPub = PassthroughSubject<Int, Never>() let lettersPub = PassthroughSubject<String, Never>() cancellable = numbersPub .zip(lettersPub) { anInt, aLetter in String(repeating: aLetter, count: anInt) } .sink { print("\($0)") } numbersPub.send(1) // numbersPub: 1 lettersPub: zip output: <none> numbersPub.send(2) // numbersPub: 1,2 lettersPub: zip output: <none> numbersPub.send(3) // numbersPub: 1,2,3 lettersPub: zip output: <none> lettersPub.send("A") // numbersPub: 1,2,3 lettersPub: "A" zip output: "A" lettersPub.send("B") // numbersPub: 2,3 lettersPub: "B" zip output: "BB" // Prints: // A // BB ```
